games.drawSchedule: Monday, Wednesday and Saturday at 10:59 PM Eastern Time (9:59 PM Central Time, 7:59 PM Pacific Time. Double Play at approximately 11:30 PM ET (10:30 PM CT, 8:30 PM PT)

powerPlay.description: Power Play prize is X times the regular prize except the jackpot winning and matching 5 of 5 numbers prize will automatically become $2 million cash. The 10X multiplier is available on jackpots up to $150 million. California does not have the Power Play option.

games.drawSchedule: Monday, Wednesday and Saturday at approximately 11:30 PM Eastern Time, right after the main Powerball drawing.
games.jackpotDescription: Double Play's top prize is a fixed $10 million cash prize — unlike the main Powerball drawing, it does not roll over and grow.
games.name: Powerball Double Play
games.payoutNote: The Power Play multiplier does not apply to Double Play prizes.

games.jackpotDescription: The top prize is $1 million a year for life; the second prize is $100,000 a year for life. Both can be taken as a lump-sum cash option instead of the annuity.
games.name: Millionaire for Life

games.drawSchedule: Weekly, Sunday at 10:00 PM Eastern Time.
games.jackpotDescription: Choose eight NFL team logos from all 32 teams. Match all eight to win the rolling cash jackpot, or match some to win a cash prize. Results are randomly drawn and not based on NFL game outcomes.
games.name: Powerball Xs & Os
games.payoutNote: $5 per play. Prizes for 4-7 of 8 matches are the standard listed amount (powerball.com/xo-prize-chart); lower-tier prizes may become pari-mutuel in some circumstances, so the actual amount paid can be less on a given drawing — this app always shows the standard amount, not a live pari-mutuel recalculation.
